text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, kitty, you're covered in mud.
I'll wipe you down, so be a good girl and sit still~~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! She jumped right over the playground equipment!
Still... it'd be awful if she caught a cold like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, kitty!
I'm not scary... Wait, whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the playground equipment acting as obstacles,
Mejiro Palmer was completely unable to catch up and ended up exhausted...
